query.snapshot: optional exact prior revision; never authority

authorization: managed certified tenant session + attendance.area.read + exact live area scope
serverPopulation: only native contracts with a proved history; unknown source candidates remain a completeness blocker
eventPopulation: exact canonical contract UUID, unique active map and proved membership on the event's own civil date
scopeOfNamesAndCounts: only the authorized subset; a foreign payload rejects the whole API response
consistency: one SQL statement snapshot for population, history, expected devices, identities and marks
expectedDevices: approved immutable declaration effective on the requested day; partial area population cannot become globally complete
civilDateMismatch: blocked before returning any source, without discarding the attributed event as an absence
readiness: PERIOD_COVERAGE_UNCONFIRMED always retained; this source does not certify absence, payroll conversion or notifications
